mainEntity.name: What is Multi-RAG and how does it achieve 87.5% accuracy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multi-RAG is a production architecture combining Standard RAG (vector search), Graph RAG (knowledge graphs via Neo4j), and Quantitative RAG (SQL-based) pipelines orchestrated through n8n workflows. It achieves 87.5% accuracy on 10,000+ questions from 18 SOTA benchmarks including HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA.

mainEntity.name: What tech stack does the Multi-RAG system use?

acceptedAnswer.text: The system uses n8n for workflow orchestration, Pinecone for vector storage, Neo4j for knowledge graphs, Supabase/PostgreSQL for structured data, Jina embeddings (1024-dim), and free-tier LLMs including Llama 3.3 70B and Gemma 3 27B via OpenRouter and Groq.

mainEntity.name: Can I use these products for my own RAG project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All products include complete source code, configuration files, and documentation. You can deploy the architecture on your own infrastructure using the included n8n workflows, evaluation scripts, and deployment guides.
